messages.author: 52c2b686b48e3db4
messages.subject: including functions from external files
parts:
I love the ability to create user-defined functions.

I don't think the manual mentions an ability to include functions from a separate file. It seems like that would be pretty helpful. Is it in the plans?

Thanks,
David


--

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] including functions from external files
parts:
Yes, it's on our medium term to-do list, so we're hoping we
can do something in a six to nine month time frame.

The plan's to just apply the C++ pre-processor to the Stan
program itself, which will support includes as well as macros
and ifdef (not that we'll be encouraging people to use those).

It introduces a headache in error reporting because we have
to keep track of the file and line number that we're in.
The preprocessor supports that but we need to figure out how
integrate it.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] including functions from external files
parts:
Oh, we also want to include a testing framework for
functions, which would make most sense for functions
defined in their own files.

The alternative plan would be to have some external
way to compile and link function includes that didn't
involve the preprocessor. But we definitely need to figure
this out. Among other things we want to supply a built-in
library of functions, and we'll need include to do that
efficiently and not drag down compile times.

- Bob
